Verified none on 7/27 and correct then; both triggers postdate it (9/8 trade, 9/10 signing) and nobody edited this file afterwards, even on 9/17 when trade_exceptions gained the Hawkins TPE created BY THAT VERY TRADE. TWO INDEPENDENT MECHANISMS, both apron1, so apron1 binds either way. (1) MATHURIN, the sturdier one, and reachable WITHOUT the label: NOP was about $23.9M over the $164.961M cap, so there was no cap room and no room exception; the taxpayer midlevel ($6.064M), the bi-annual ($5.477M) and every minimum are too small; a trade exception cannot sign a free agent; a sign-and-trade is impossible on a 2-year deal against snt_min_years_excl_options=3. The non-taxpayer midlevel is what is left. The 5% raise limit closes the escape: on a 2-year deal year one is at least total/2.05, so at EVERY reported total ($15.375M HR, $16M ours and BBRef) year one is at least $7.5M, $1.4M above the taxpayer portion. A salary error cannot change the mechanism. (2) THE 9/8 TRADE: AJ Johnson ($3,237,120) in against Micah Peavy ($2,150,917) alone, with Hawkins going out unmatched to create the full $7,021,895 TPE this repo already records and Gibson arriving on the minimum exception. NOT A TRIGGER, DO NOT CITE IT: the Feb 2026 Alvarado TPE never fired. The 9/24 check-in still lists two NOP exceptions available with the largest worth $7M, so prior-season TPE use did not happen. OUR INFERENCE, NAMED: the phrase more than 100% is ours, not a quote. The tracker says only expanded traded player exception. The 150.5% is computed from the sources' own figures; on a WHOLE-TRADE basis NOP took back just 36.9%, which is why the tooltip names the Johnson-against-Peavy pairing and not the trade totals. SOURCING LIMIT, stated because it is the real weakness: every outlet asserting this cap is Hoops Rumors. Spotrac 403s this machine and HoopsHype and RealGM disallow us by name, so there was no independent second publisher to break the tie. The elimination argument in (1) is what carries this row, not the citation. REVERSE ONLY IF a publication reports NOP did not use the midlevel on Mathurin. A hard cap cannot be lifted once triggered, so later news can only add capped teams.
